items.title: Fall Asleep in Foggy Victorian London | Gaslight Sleep Story (47 Min)
items.description:
Walk home slowly through a soft yellow London fog on a November evening around 1880. Watch the lamplighter turn each gas lamp into a golden halo, stroll along the river wall past the dolphin lamps and Cleopatra's Needle, warm your hands at a chestnut brazier by the cabmen's shelter, and end in a quiet parlour with a coal fire, toasted muffins and a ticking clock.

No crime and no drama, only gentle narration, soft rain and a long ambient ending so you can drift off.
